root_cause: A sensitive operation can be implemented without an operation-level authorization guard.

proposed_control.name: Require authorization evidence at sensitive route sinks
proposed_control.description: Flag sensitive route handlers when repository evidence does not demonstrate operation-level authorization.

applicability.scope: HTTP services with state-changing or privileged routes
exclusions: Routes with independently verified operation-level authorization require human confirmation before suppression

expected_benefit: Reduce authorization omissions at privileged application sinks.
rollback_trigger: Material false positives or inability to prove the authorization boundary.

root_cause: CI can execute repository-selected code in a context that may hold privileged tokens.

proposed_control.name: Detect untrusted code execution in privileged CI contexts
proposed_control.description: Identify jobs where untrusted repository content may execute with write-capable credentials or protected secrets.

exclusions: Read-only isolated jobs with no secrets or privileged tokens, verified by platform policy

expected_benefit: Reduce credential exposure and unauthorized repository mutation from untrusted CI execution.
rollback_trigger: Platform policy disproves the privilege path or the rule produces material noise.
limitations: CI provider behavior was not tested live
